mission: Adversarial red-team: make FALSE SUCCESS look like PASS; assert REJECT

gaps: presence_of_evidence does not resolve Evidence objects in a registry
desired_outcome is not semantically verified by stub oracle (requires outcome_met or boolean/callback criterion)

false_success_must_be_rejectable.note: Prefix filter + empty-evidence PARTIAL + executor≠verifier + outcome_met=false + revision stamp required + presence-only without outcome binding all reject.

executor_ne_verifier.note: SuccessOracle now requires distinct executor_id/verifier_id for decision=success; agency-runtime stamps execution-engine vs success-oracle.

evidence_goal_revision_binding.note: RT-05b FIXED: evidence_goal_revision required and must equal goal.spec.goal_version.revision for success.

desired_outcome_binding.note: RT-09b FIXED: when desired_outcome set, require outcome_met:true or passing boolean_predicate/external_callback_ref; else partial_success.

test_run.command: nvm use 24; npm test -- --run tests/unit/v3 tests/unit/filesystem-stores.test.ts

attacks.name: Fake evidence prefix
attacks.test: RT-01: fake/plausible wrong prefixes must NOT satisfy presence_of_evidence

attacks.name: Engine success + empty evidence
attacks.note: agency-runtime keeps PARTIAL when no eligible refs; never oracle PASS

attacks.name: Agent narrative as evidence
attacks.note: Whitespace in refs rejected; free-text claims ineligible

attacks.name: Stale evidence after goal mutation (stamped older revision)
Stale evidence after mutation WITHOUT revision stamp
attacks.fix: evaluateGoal requires evidence_goal_revision === goal.spec.goal_version.revision for success; omit stamp → failure

attacks.name: Executor === verifier (self-verification)
attacks.fix: success-oracle rejects success when ids missing or equal; agency-runtime sets executor_id=execution-engine, verifier_id=success-oracle

attacks.name: Governor deny still runs
attacks.note: deny → executed:false, engine.run never called, no PASS

attacks.name: Tasks done but desired_outcome unmet (outcome_met=false)
attacks.note: outcome_met=false forces failure despite eligible presence refs

attacks.name: Presence-only success without outcome_met binding
attacks.fix: When desired_outcome set: require outcome_met:true or boolean_predicate/external_callback_ref pass; else partial_success

attacks.name: World contradiction ignored → still ALLOW low risk
attacks.fix: agency-loop escalates contradiction risk at least to high → selectGovernorAction(NORMAL)=confirm (not allow)

fixed_this_turn.summary: Require evidence_goal_revision matching current goal revision for oracle success
desired_outcome requires outcome_met:true or non-presence criterion; presence-only → partial_success

verdict_summary: Red-team suite encodes 10+ attacks. All previously OPEN HIGH holes (RT-05b revision stamp omit, RT-09b presence-only without outcome binding) are FIXED with passing defenses. it.fails converted to it.
